titles_native.title: オフィスパートナー～境界線を越えて～

description:
Cha Min-Young has been busy every day serving her friend Yoon Tae-Ha, whom she has known for over 20 years, as her boss. Due to the shock of being betrayed by her boyfriend, she ends up having a one-night stand with Tae-Ha. After that impulsive night, Min-Young realizes that the old feelings she has felt for Tae-Ha were not just jealousy.
